invocation: for d in /sys/class/infiniband/*; do echo "DEVICE $d"; readlink -f "$d/device"; ls -l "$d/device/net"; for p in "$d"/ports/*; do echo "PORT $p"; for f in state phys_state rate link_layer active_mtu lid; do echo "FILE $p/$f"; cat "$p/$f"; done; for f in "$p"/gid_attrs/ndevs/* "$p"/gid_attrs/types/* "$p"/gids/* "$p"/counters/* "$p"/hw_counters/*; do echo "FILE $f"; cat "$f"; done; done; done
